name: holter-diary
description: A minimal local-first Holter monitoring diary

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-app-build.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-offline.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:policy && npm run test:release && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser && npm run test:app && npm run test:webkit && npm run test:site
scripts.test:webkit: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.webkit.config.ts
scripts.test:app: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.app.config.ts
scripts.deps:install: node scripts/check-dependency-policy.mjs && npm run audit:dependencies && npm ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && playwright test --config playwright.site.config.ts
